name: Makera Carvera
notes: EU store price (5th-anniversary sale; regular €5,849). Includes 6-tool ATC, wireless probe, automatic tool-length calibration, integrated 2.5 W laser and internal dust collection (0.8 l tank). Guides are mixed: X/Z 15 mm linear rails, Y 25 mm hardened rods; ball screws on all axes; servo motors on X/Y/Z. Accuracy = stated resolution. Custom collet (1/8" standard; 1/4", 6, 4, 3 mm optional). Supports external air assist. Optional 4th axis (Ø92 × 240 mm).

accessories.name: Carvera 4th Axis Module Harmonic Drive
accessories.description: Harmonic-drive rotary module with 4th-axis homing for simultaneous 4-axis machining (Ø92 × 240 mm).

accessories.name: Makera Cyclone Dust Collector
accessories.description: Full-size cyclone dust collector with automated control for long, continuous milling jobs.

accessories.name: Makera Fixture Set for Carvera & Carvera Air
accessories.description: Two side clamps and a thick L-bracket for holding workpieces thicker than 2 cm.
